name: Arrakis world

sections.body: SoA_Biome_DeepErg, SoA_Biome_RockyBasin, and SoA_Biome_ShieldWall replace the surface fantasy. Deep erg is maker country with almost no rock. Rocky basin is sietch country. Shield wall is escarpment and canyon.
sections.title: Biomes

sections.body: Scenario SoA_Scenario_FremenSietch forces the Arrakis supported world, stillsuits and reclamation masks, and starting sandwalking 10–15. Automotive junk gen steps are suppressed on Arrakis biomes.
sections.title: Supported start

summary: The supported play path is an Arrakis world of deep erg, rocky basin, and shield wall — not a random vanilla biome mix.
